region_note: SENIOR / DISABILITY / ILLNESS - in-home pet care
notes: free in-home help (dog walking, feeding, litter, vet-trip coordination) for low-income seniors and people with illness/disability who struggle with daily pet care. Apply at pawsny.org; (212) 203-4760. Case-by-case eligibility.
